payload.title: The infrastructure-policy adapter does not de-duplicate overlapping roots, so a file reachable through two roots is read twice and yields duplicate observation ids and doubled findings, and the test that claims to cover this runs only the production roots, where no overlap exists
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/infrastructure-policy-adapter.ts:390-403 (flatMap over scanRoots into a plain array; no Set before collected)
tools/aria-adapters/infrastructure-policy-adapter.ts:571-581 (every collected entry is classified, counted and read, so a repeated path is processed twice)
tools/aria-adapters/infrastructure-policy-adapter.ts:1046-1060 (one observation id infrastructure-policy-adapter:file:<path> is pushed per collected entry)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tool_runner.py:131 (caller-supplied roots override default_input, so a tool run can pass overlapping roots)
tools/aria-adapters/infrastructure-policy-adapter.test.ts:1546-1553 (the 'file under two roots is one observation' test runs manifest.default_input.roots, which has no overlap)
tools/aria-adapters/infrastructure-policy-adapter.tool.json:64-85 (the production roots: no root contains another)
payload.rule_violated: One observation and one claim per file (adapter header: one observation per file); a test named for the overlap case must be able to fail on the adapter.
payload.notes: With roots ['apps', 'apps/sensor-ingestion/Dockerfile'] the Dockerfile is collected through the directory walk and as a file root; the loop at line 1046 pushes two observations with the same id, the claims loop emits each finding twice (distinct fingerprints through the occurrence counter), summary.files and the byte budget count it twice. The package removed the one overlapping manifest root instead of making the adapter overlap-safe, and the test at line 1546 would stay green if the adapter regressed, because the production roots never overlap (its comment still says the file is a root of its own today). Close condition: De-duplicate `collected` (a Set over normalised paths) in the adapter and change the test to call analyzeInfrastructurePolicy with overlapping roots, asserting one observation id and one claim per file. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 2b). Verified at head b2259fe03f of open pull request #2151; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
